found.name: Generative AI and your studies guide
found.quote: Learn about AI, how it can help you with your studies and how you are allowed to use AI tools in your assessed work.
To use AI effectively, you need to ask the right questions. This is known as prompt engineering and is the practice of crafting clear, specific, and purposeful prompts to guide the AI’s response.

found.quote: Students should make use of formative assessments, Subject Librarians, the Study Support team, and the academic experts at their school or college to practice and develop their AI knowledge.
